subject: Install Storybook dependencies and publish executable lab

argv: storybook: bootstrap executable Doré design knowledge lab

body: Root cause from storybook-root-cause-2 is explicit: command 6 returned 127 with `sh: storybook: command not found`; Node v26.7.0 and npm 11.19.0 are available and the Storybook package/config/source directory exists locally. This task changes hypothesis from diagnosis to targeted dependency installation. Install declared dependencies, build the static Storybook, verify index.html, and commit only reproducible source/config/package lock. node_modules and storybook-static are ignored and must not be committed. Preserve the locked #262 homepage and Journal. On any failure, return command-level stdout/stderr/returncode.
